** _HTML element_ ```typescript const element: HTMLElementTagNameMap["div"] ``` Groups content without adding a specific semantic meaning. **Editor behavior** - Go-to-definition uses TypeScript DOM lib data when the type service is available. - Component resolution is skipped for this tag because it is part of the platform DOM surface. **Example** ```vue ``` **Docs** [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/div) [HTML Living Standard](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/grouping-content.html#the-div-element)
